extraction.method: manual transcription of the rendered scanned pages; no OCR and no provider call
notes: The PDF has no text layer: every page is a set of image tiles, so the text below was read from rendered pages.

One criterion per printed mark point. Alternative schemes (M2 for two method marks, B2 for two marks) are recorded in 'alternatives' and never as extra rows, so the criteria capacity of a question always equals its maximum.
Descriptions are ASCII so the SymPy scheme check can read the answer; the printed form is kept in 'expected_answer' and 'source_quote'.
Nothing was inferred: a mark point that the scheme does not print was not invented.

Q16(d) is printed on scheme page 6 (2 marks, x2 + 4x - 21) but the blueprint carries only 16(b), so this document totals the paper's 89 scoreable marks and not the scheme's 91 printed ones; the exclusion is listed in experiment/supervised_pilot/excluded_scheme_entries.csv.
Q5's printed acceptance column repeats its second operand ('2x + x2 or x2 + x2'). The intended reading, x2 + 2x, is recorded here and the printed text is kept in source_quote.

Q14's printed method cell reads 'y2 + 4k + ...' for the expansion of (k + 9)(k - 5). The variable is a typographical slip for k2 and the constant is printed as an ellipsis, so the row records 'k^2 + 4k + a' and keeps the printed text in source_quote.

An independent audit of the printed pages found seven transcription faults (Q1d cao omitted, Q4 tolerance invented, Q6 alternative invented, Q13 tolerances dropped and a condition added, Q19 non-zero condition dropped, Q27 2-of-3 tolerance dropped, Q34 routes dropped). All seven are corrected here and pinned by backend/tests/unit/test_pilot_scheme_criteria.py.
